en: Color postcard view of a grand historic building complex in a European city, showing a neo‑baroque theater or opera house with statues on its domed towers and ornate façade, attached to a more restrained classical administrative building on the left. In front is a circular plaza with patterned flower beds and a small conifer tree, bordered by wide streets with crosswalks, 1960s–1970s style buses and cars, traffic signs, and pedestrians. The scene is framed as a typical tourist view of a major civic landmark.
